    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: One real text input carries the whole code, so screen readers hear one field ("Verification code, 6 digits") instead of six
      - listitem: autocomplete="one-time-code" lets iOS and Android offer the code from an SMS; inputMode="numeric" opens the number pad
      - listitem: Errors set aria-invalid and point to the message with aria-describedby; verifying, errors, success and resend are announced in a polite live region
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A single blue focus outline glides from box to box with a thin, softly blinking blue caret; digits pop in out of a short blur
      - listitem: Pasted or autofilled codes fill the boxes one after another
      - listitem: "Verifying: the digits turn gray and a lighter band passes over the white boxes. Error: a calm shake, a faint red fill and red digits, the message grows in below and the code fades out for the next try"
      - listitem: "Success: the boxes slide together while one frame morphs its width into a \"Verified\" chip with a faint green fill and the check draws in"
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Container query: the boxes shrink to fit their container – six boxes with a separator fit a 320px phone"
      - listitem: Inputs use 16px text under the hood, so iOS doesn't zoom in on focus
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
